runs.description: pictures: def, neon, duplication 0.2 a birth (x10), 300 s

evals.js: const w = (await moire.dup.where(40, 'new')).concat(await moire.dup.where(40)); if (!w.length) return 'none'; const c = w[0]; moire.camera.set(5, c.x, c.y); return JSON.stringify(w.slice(0, 6))
